evaluatedInstruction: What happened in this decision? Answer the five scenario questions.

selectedOption.summary: Invite-only, single-tenant Northstar beta Oct 15, 2026; GA Nov 1, 2026

answer.whatWasDecided: Proceed with the invite-only, single-tenant Northstar beta on Oct 15, 2026, followed by GA by Nov 1, 2026.
answer.why: Capacity fell to 14 days because of a four-day incident rotation. The beta fits those 14 days, preserves four post-launch days, and meets Northstar Health’s Nov 1 usable-export deadline.
answer.whatChanged: Capacity changed from 18 to 14 days. The Ratiflow demo agent recommended and prepared the decision through WebMCP; it was then ratified in the ordinary UI.
answer.whatRemainsOpen: All 14 launch days are consumed with no pre-beta buffer, and four post-launch days may be insufficient if beta feedback is material. A follow-up is READY for Maya Chen, due Oct 16, 2026.
answer.whoRatified: Maya Chen, Product Lead, ratified it in the ordinary UI.

executionMode: A fresh nested gpt-5.6-terra/medium decider chose both read-only calls from native descriptions; the coordinator relayed them unchanged through one isolated in-app Browser WebMCP handle.
